peak-trucking.changelog:
- Major server DB performance refactor: O(1) hash map player indexing, lazy DB loading, and cached leaderboard stats.
- Added non-blocking promise-based SQL bridge and ExecuteSqlAsync for database operations.
- Consolidated initial player data sync into single payload network event (SyncAllPlayerData).
- Made Discord avatar fetching asynchronous and non-blocking.
- Optimized client proximity math with squared distance vector math and screen-clipping guards on 3D text.
